title: The Exterior and What’s Not-Self in the Three Times

  • 17. Saṭṭhipeyyālavagga 17. Sixty Abbreviated Texts

Bāhirātītādiyadanattasutta The Exterior and What’s Not-Self in the Three Times

“Rūpā, bhikkhave, anattā atītā anāgatā paccuppannā. “Mendicants, in the past … future … present sights, sounds, smells, tastes, touches, and ideas are not-self. Yadanattā, taṁ ‘netaṁ mama, nesohamasmi, na meso attā’ti evametaṁ yathābhūtaṁ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṁ. And what’s not-self should be truly seen with right understanding like this: ‘This is not mine, I am not this, this is not my self.’ …” Saddā … gandhā … rasā … phoṭṭhabbā … dhammā anattā atītā anāgatā paccuppannā. Yadanattā, taṁ ‘netaṁ mama, nesohamasmi, na meso attā’ti evametaṁ yathābhūtaṁ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṁ.

Evaṁ passaṁ …pe… nāparaṁ itthattāyāti pajānātī”ti.
